Label: Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire
Description: Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire (BMRQ). Measures individual differences in the experience of reward from music across five facets (musical seeking, emotion evocation, mood regulation, social reward, sensory-motor). 20 items, 5-point scale. Reference: Mas-Herrero, E., Marco-Pallares, J., Lorenzo-Seva, U., Zatorre, R. J., & Rodriguez-Fornells, A. (2013). Individual differences in music reward experiences. Music Perception, 31(2), 118-138.
